chapterInfo.content:
6
1 # Eks 11.1; 12.33 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Afei ansa na worebɛhunu deɛ mɛyɛ Farao, ɛfiri sɛ mede nsa a ɛyɛ den bɛma wama wɔakɔ, na mede nsa a ɛyɛ den bɛma wapamo wɔn afiri n’asase so mpo.
Onyankopɔn frɛ Mose
2Na Onyankopɔn ne Mose kasae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE, 3#Gye 17.1; Eks 3.14-15 a meyii me ho mekyerɛɛ Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob sɛ Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, na me din YHWH (AWURADE) no deɛ, mamma wɔamfa anhu me. 4#Gye 12.7 Nanso mama m’apam a me ne wɔn pameeɛ no agyina, sɛ mede Kanaan asase a ɛyɛ wɔn ahɔhobea asase a wɔyɛɛ so ahɔhoɔ no bɛma wɔn. 5Nanso mate Israelfoɔ a Misraimfoɔ di wɔn nya no apinisie, na makae m’apam no. 6Ɛno nti ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Mene AWURADE, na mɛgye mo afiri Misraim nkoasom mu, na mayi mo afiri wɔn nyadie no mu, na mede basa a atene ne atemmuo akɛseɛ magye mo. 7Na mɛfa mo mayɛ me man, na mayɛ Onyankopɔn ama mo, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a ɔgyee mo firii Misraim nkoasom mu. 8#Gye 22.16; Deut 32.40 Na mede mo bɛkɔ asase a mekaa ntam sɛ mede bɛma Abraham, Isak, Yakob no so, na mede bɛma mo sɛ agyapadeɛ. Mene AWURADE. 9Na Mose kaa saa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no; nanso ahometeɛ ne nkoasom denden no nti wɔantie no. 10Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 11Kɔ, kɔka kyerɛ Misraimhene Farao sɛ ɔmma Israelfoɔ mfiri n’asase so nkɔ. 12#Eks 6.30; 4.10 Na Mose kasae wɔ AWURADE anim sɛ: Hwɛ, Israelfoɔ ntie me, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Farao bɛtie me a meyɛ ano mu momonoto yi. 13Na AWURADE ne Mose ne Aaron kasae, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ Israelfoɔ ne Misraimhene Farao nkyɛn nkɔyi Israelfoɔ no mfiri Misraim asase so.
Mose ne Aaron mmusua
14 # Gye 46.9-11 Yeinom ne wɔn nananom afie mu atitire: Israel abakan Ruben mma ne: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi; yeinom ne Ruben mmusua.
15Na Simeon mma ne: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar ne Saulo a ɔyɛ Kanaanni baa bi ba; yeinom ne Simeon mmusua.
16 # 1 Be 6.1-4, 16-19 Na yeinom ne Lewi mma din wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari. Na Lewi mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa nson. 17Na Gerson mma ne: Libni ne Simei wɔ wɔn mmusua ahodoɔ mu. 18Na Kohat mma ne: Amram ne Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel. Na Kohat mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa mmiɛnsa. 19Na Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Yeinom ne Lewi mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ. 20#Eks 2.1 Na Amram faa n’agya nua Yokebed waree, na ɔwoo Aaron ne Mose maa no. Na Amram mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa nson. 21#Num 16.1 Na Ishar mma ne: Kora, Nefeg ne Sikri. 22#Lew 10.4 Na Usiel mma ne: Misael, Elsafan ne Sitri. 23#Eks 28.1 Na Aaron faa Aminadab babaa Elisaba a ɔyɛ Nahson nua waree, na ɔwoo Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar maa no. 24Na Kora mma ne: Asir, Elkana ne Abiasaf; yeinom ne Kora mma mmusua. 25#Num 25.7 Na Aaron ba Eleasa faa Putiel mma mu bi waree, na ɔwoo Pinehas maa no. Yeinom ne Lewifoɔ nananom atitire sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 26Yeinom ne Aaron ne Mose a AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyi Israelfoɔ mfiri Misraim asase so sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm teɛ no. 27Wɔne wɔn a wɔne Misraimhene Farao kasaa sɛ wɔbɛyi Israelfoɔ afiri Misraim akorɔ no, Mose ne Aaron korɔ no ara nie.
AWURADE DE N’ASƐM MA MOSE
28Na da a AWURADE ne Mose kasaa Misraim asase soɔ no, 29ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE, ka deɛ mɛka makyerɛ woɔ nyinaa kyerɛ Misraimhene Farao. 30#Eks 6.12 Na Mose kaa no AWURADE anim sɛ: Hwɛ, ano mu momonoto ne me, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Farao bɛtie me?

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Afei ansa na worebɛhunu deɛ mɛyɛ Farao, ɛfiri sɛ mede nsa a ɛyɛ den bɛma wama wɔakɔ, na mede nsa a ɛyɛ den bɛma wapamo wɔn afiri n’asase so mpo.

Na Onyankopɔn ne Mose kasae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE, a meyii me ho mekyerɛɛ Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob sɛ Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, na me din YHWH (AWURADE) no deɛ, mamma wɔamfa anhu me. Nanso mama m’apam a me ne wɔn pameeɛ no agyina, sɛ mede Kanaan asase a ɛyɛ wɔn ahɔhobea asase a wɔyɛɛ so ahɔhoɔ no bɛma wɔn. Na mede mo bɛkɔ asase a mekaa ntam sɛ mede bɛma Abraham, Isak, Yakob no so, na mede bɛma mo sɛ agyapadeɛ. Mene AWURADE. Na Mose kaa saa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no; nanso ahometeɛ ne nkoasom denden no nti wɔantie no. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔ, kɔka kyerɛ Misraimhene Farao sɛ ɔmma Israelfoɔ mfiri n’asase so nkɔ. Na Mose kasae wɔ AWURADE anim sɛ: Hwɛ, Israelfoɔ ntie me, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Farao bɛtie me a meyɛ ano mu momonoto yi. Yeinom ne wɔn nananom afie mu atitire: Israel abakan Ruben mma ne: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi; yeinom ne Ruben mmusua.
Na Simeon mma ne: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar ne Saulo a ɔyɛ Kanaanni baa bi ba; yeinom ne Simeon mmusua.
Na yeinom ne Lewi mma din wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari. Na Lewi mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa nson. Na Gerson mma ne: Libni ne Simei wɔ wɔn mmusua ahodoɔ mu. Na Kohat mma ne: Amram ne Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel. Na Kohat mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa mmiɛnsa. Na Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Yeinom ne Lewi mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ. Na Amram faa n’agya nua Yokebed waree, na ɔwoo Aaron ne Mose maa no. Na Amram mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa nson. Na Ishar mma ne: Kora, Nefeg ne Sikri. Na Usiel mma ne: Misael, Elsafan ne Sitri. Na Aaron ba Eleasa faa Putiel mma mu bi waree, na ɔwoo Pinehas maa no. Yeinom ne Lewifoɔ nananom atitire sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Wɔne wɔn a wɔne Misraimhene Farao kasaa sɛ wɔbɛyi Israelfoɔ afiri Misraim akorɔ no, Mose ne Aaron korɔ no ara nie.

Na da a AWURADE ne Mose kasaa Misraim asase soɔ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE, ka deɛ mɛka makyerɛ woɔ nyinaa kyerɛ Misraimhene Farao. Na Mose kaa no AWURADE anim sɛ: Hwɛ, ano mu momonoto ne me, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Farao bɛtie me?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
